correctness.rationale: The stated eigenvalues follow directly by Fourier diagonalization. A fully proved cyclotomic sign lemma restricts any opposite-parity eigenvalue collision to two explicit rational-cosine pairs; parity then gives precisely n=3 mod 6 and n=2 mod 4. Orthogonal spectral projection gives the exact fractions; dissipative spectral theory ensures all bright modes decay for every positive loss strength. 78 spectral computations, eight exact rational Krylov ranks, and ten dissipative-eigenvalue checks corroborate but do not replace the all-n proof.

Its exceptional set has two genuinely arithmetic families and contrasts almost-half-dimensional dark spaces with certain absorption from a special source. The cyclotomic obstruction is substantive, not a normalization or numerical fit.
